name: Animal Tags
description: Craft small dyed-leather animal tags and clip them to your livestock so you can tell individual animals apart at a glance. Ten colours, one per vanilla leather dye, and two ears per animal for a hundred distinct combinations. Supports sheep, pigs, all eleven goat breeds, and chickens - where the same tag becomes a leg band. Metal tags, smithed from an ingot in twenty-one metals, catch the light the way an ingot does and make the wearer immune to anything the player does to it, so a prize breeder never meets the cleaver by accident.
